dedupe_keys.name: captaciones depositos y estaciones depuradoras en la rioja

description: Captaciones, depósitos y estaciones depuradoras en La Rioja is a dataset listed in Official INSPIRE Data and Services Catalogue, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by inspire.larioja.org. Information on collections, deposits and treatment plants in La Rioja. This information is part of a WMS 1.3.0 and WFS 2.0 service of the Government of La Rioja that complies with what is defined by INSPIRE and its Implementing Rules in relation to the requirements of a visualization and download service. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Collections, deposits and treatment plants in La Rioja" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 3 download or service links in WFS, WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/noConditionsApply). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-codsi.
